Date: 2027-05-02T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service disruption on 2027-05-01 — uptime calc (draft)

Naomi / team —

I pulled the request logs and billing records for Aurora (deal HUB-3921) and prepared a draft calculation. See attached spreadsheet (uptime_calc_aurora_2027-05-02.xlsx). Summary below:

- Incident window (redwood request logs, us-west-2): 2027-05-01T01:03:00-07:00 to 2027-05-01T03:12:00-07:00 => 129 minutes total
- SLA target uptime for region: 99.95% monthly (per sla_clause_snapshot.pdf)
- For the 30-day period that includes 2027-05-01, Aurora's billed committed monthly spend = $72,000 (pre-tax).
- Per SLA: cumulative monthly unavailability beyond threshold maps to credit bands. Using our standard banding (see spreadsheet): the measured unavailability for the month translates to a 7.5% service credit of monthly committed spend.
- Calculated credit (draft): 0.075 * $72,000 = $5,400.

Notes / assumptions:
- Calculation prorates against committed monthly spend (per contract). If Aurora prefers per-usage refund instead of a credit, that can be computed similarly but requires mapping to per-token usage which is slower to reconcile.
- The attached workbook includes raw log time slices we used and the band thresholds.

Action items:
- Evelyn: please confirm approval to issue a $5,400 credit to Aurora (invoice adjustment) or advise alternate GL code and method.
- Naomi: once Evelyn signs off I can generate the credit memo and route it to billing@auroraanalytics.com for bookkeeping.

Rishi
Senior Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
attachments: uptime_calc_aurora_2027-05-02.xlsx
